cardio_train_binary_classification.grouping_key: id column — but this is a sequential integer, not a true patient encounter ID. No documented repeated-measurement information. Assume one row per patient unless documentation contradicts.
cardio_train_binary_classification.recommendation: Patient-independent split by id (assuming each id = 1 patient). Stratified by label (cardio) to preserve class balance.
leakage_risks: Height and weight may correlate strongly with age and BMI — ensure no circular feature derivation.
ap_lo (diastolic BP) and ap_hi (systolic BP) are direct risk markers — must not be derived from label.
Implausible blood pressure values (e.g., ap_lo > ap_hi, extreme outliers) must be identified and handled before splitting.
cardio_train_binary_classification.preprocessing_rule: All scalers, normalizers fitted on train split ONLY. Val/test receive train-fitted transforms.

NBME_NLP_phrase_identification.task: NLP phrase identification: character-span extraction from clinical notes
NBME_NLP_phrase_identification.grouping_key: pn_num (patient note ID) — split by pn_num to ensure the same note never appears in both train and val
NBME_NLP_phrase_identification.recommendation: Hold out notes by pn_num. Do NOT allow the same note to appear in both train and val.
leakage_risks: BioClinicalBERT tokenizer must be applied using pre-trained vocabulary, not fitted on this dataset. No leakage risk from tokenizer.
test.csv from Kaggle has withheld labels — cannot be used for evaluation. Use train/val split only.
Split by pn_num (not by annotation row id) to prevent the same note appearing in train and validation.

PTB-XL_ECG.recommendation: BLOCKED — cannot define a split without signal data. If waveform data is added in future: split by patient_id column in ptbxl_database.csv. PTB-XL provides recommended splits (strat_fold field). Per-lead z-score normalization must be fitted on train folds only.
